name: forge04
note: earshot 0.4 recipe members (render blocks of recipe palettes): the new categories and new members of old ones; each entry carries its catalog profile, its take audit and its originality (the largest CLAP cosine to a private set of licensed reference clips, <= 0.96)

cut_hit.target: a short deep sub bass hit with a kick drum
cut_hit.use: a short sub hit with a kick, or a short punchy hit, on a cut (0.2-0.5 s)

reverse_swell.use: a reverse cymbal / reverse swell that peaks just after a cut (at most one a film)

ui_pop.target: a soft rounded pop, a small bubble popping in a user interface
ui_pop.use: soft rounded mid pops for elements arriving: chips, bubbles, rows

knock.target: a knock on a wooden block
knock.use: mid-band wood and plastic knocks (0.1-0.2 s)

mallet.use: short gated mallet notes (glockenspiel, celesta, marimba), a soft pluck, chime runs

drip.target: a water drop falling into water, a drip
drip.use: water drops: a bubble whose pitch rises (the audit allows a bubble its climb)

shutter.use: camera shutters: a two-stage mechanical click for snap zooms and whip-cuts

cut_hit/sub.notes: a short sub hit, 225 -> 46 Hz, with a kick and a low punch

cut_hit/kick.notes: a kick-led sub hit: the beater lifts it to ~275 Hz

cut_hit/punch.notes: a short punchy cut hit (0.28 s), two thirds under 150 Hz

cut_hit/rumble.notes: a kick on a slow sub drop into a wide granular rumble (1.4 s)

cut_hit/air.notes: a fast wide sub hit under a sustained bright air band

reverse_swell/cymbal.notes: a bright wide reverse cymbal: a plateau after the peak, then a stop

reverse_swell/ring.notes: a reverse cymbal that swells harder and rings out

reverse_swell/dark.notes: a darker, near-mono reverse swell with a low body

reverse_swell/short.notes: a short bright reverse cymbal for a quick cut (0.33 s to the peak)

reverse_swell/breath.notes: a mid-band reverse breath, half wide (1.3 kHz)

ui_pop/soft.notes: a soft rounded mid pop: 550 Hz, 22 ms onset, t20 75 ms

ui_pop/step.notes: the soft pop a step higher, falling 3 st

ui_pop/blip.notes: a bright 890 Hz blip, fully decorrelated (L / R correlation ~0.1)

ui_pop/fall.notes: an eased 7 st fall with a faint second pop

ui_pop/wide.notes: a wide 620 Hz pop with a lip click (correlation ~0.5)

knock/wood.notes: a mid-band wooden knock: a 400 Hz block and its faint rattle

knock/plastic.notes: a plastic click that bounces back 18 ms later (2.4 kHz)

knock/snap.notes: a soft contact, then a bright plastic snap with a bounce (3 kHz)

knock/desk.notes: a knuckle on a desk: a low wooden knock with the table under it

knock/double.notes: a knock-knock: two wooden taps 55 ms apart

mallet/glock.notes: a gated glockenspiel note doubled an octave under (0.35 s)

mallet/celesta.notes: a wide celesta note (G5, L / R correlation ~0.5), gated

mallet/marimba.notes: a short dry wooden marimba note (G4)

mallet/flourish.notes: a quick three-note chime flourish in an arc, near mono

mallet/up4.notes: four gated chime notes up a pentatonic scale in skips, 110 ms apart, panned note by note

drip/drop.notes: a water drop: a 306 Hz bubble rising 8 st within 40 ms, soft onset

drip/bubble.notes: a lower bubble rising 10 st with a daughter bubble

drip/plink.notes: a small high plink rising 3 st

drip/bloop.notes: a big drop's slow bloop: ~5 st over 0.1-0.15 s (the audit's drip allowance)

drip/tiny.notes: a tiny fast droplet at 1.15 kHz, 0.1 s

shutter/dslr.notes: a camera shutter: latch, 39 ms of curtain travel, the landing on a 1.4 kHz box

shutter/snap.notes: a dry, bright 2 kHz snap-zoom shutter

shutter/mirror.notes: a slower mirror-box shutter with an audible travel

shutter/film.notes: a heavier film camera: a dark box after 95 ms of travel, the body's thump, a spring rattle

shutter/quick.notes: a quick double click: release and curtain 21 ms apart

notify/mid_tine.notes: a rounded mid ding: a felt-struck tine over its octave (690 Hz, 32 ms onset)

notify/mid_wood.notes: a soft wooden bar with its octave body, a step higher

whoosh_big/thump.notes: a big low whoosh that lands with a thump (~80 ms in, rings ~0.35 s)

riser/dark.notes: a short dark riser (noise, sub, a speeding stutter), no synth sweep

riser/build.notes: a sub-heavy build with crackle and a speeding gate (1.1 s)

riser/snatch.notes: a half-second stutter snatch into a cut

swish/flick.notes: a high flick that rises and stops dead, wide

whoosh_fast/whip.notes: a designed bright whip: a wide ring that falls

glitch/burst.notes: crackle, then bright bursts that hit first and speed up

glitch/mid.notes: a short mid glitch that hits first

glitch/chirp.notes: a pitched data-chirp stutter that hits first
